text_block_list.text:
Голд Сити doesn't feel well, so I take her
to the
infirmary to get some rest.

Sorry, but I'm going to close my eyes for
a
second. I'll set an alarm, just in case.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: AAAHHH!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Whew, what a roller coaster! I haven't
screamed
like that in a while!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Welcome back! Hope you have a great
time in the
amusement park of your
dreams!
text_block_list.name: Amusement Park Staff

text_block_list.text:
Let's see, what next? There's teacups, or
the
pirate adventures...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Might I also recommend a gourmet tour?
Take a
look at our brochure!
text_block_list.name: Amusement Park Staff

text_block_list.text: Oh, really? Sounds like a good idea.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: BEEP! BEEP! BEEP! BEEP!
Agh! Geez, what is that?! It's so loud!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: It sounds like... my alarm clock?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Ahhh! That's right! I have to go!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
The parade will be starting soon! Why
don't you
stay and enjoy a little more?
text_block_list.name: Amusement Park Staff

text_block_list.text: Yeah, I know. I was having fun.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: But having fun isn't enough.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Because... I have to run!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: What? It was just a dream?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Heheh. "I have to run," huh? Yeah, that's
right!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Attention, customers. We would like to
make an
apology.
text_block_list.name: Announcement

text_block_list.text: Huh?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
The alert you just heard was triggered
by our
maintenance staff to test the
system. We
apologize for any
inconvenience caused.
text_block_list.name: Announcement

text_block_list.text:
Oh, okay... I guess I'll go to the next
ride.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Wait, I've overslept!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Голд Сити regains her energy and hops
right back
in to her training.

Голд Сити seems disappointed she
overslept well
past her schedule.
